HIDDEN LINE, CLOSE UP{n} fat scan lines run top to bottom over {src}, veryclose. A black surface under the lines hides the ones behind.	HIDDEN LINE, CLOSE UP{n} fat scan lines run top to bottom over {src}, veryclose. A black surface under the lines hides the ones behind.

MONITOR WALLOne scan-line signal on {tiles} tubes, no two set up alike:colour, brightness, hold, mirror, zoom and polarity differ.	MONITOR WALLOne scan-line signal on {tiles} tubes, no two set up alike:colour, brightness, hold, mirror, zoom and polarity differ.
